name: Creaky Old Swordsman
subtitle: i'm getting too old for this shit
flavor: "...he says if I don't grease him up first he just can't seem to get into it..."

name: Deadly Striker
subtitle: rock you like a hurricane
rules: If this card is destroyed, your opponent's faction loses 4 influence.
flavor:
Dear Sir or Madam:
The Imperial Army regrets to inform you that your son(s) are dead because they got blown up. Sorry for the inconvenience.
Best wishes,
Praxis, Grand General of Bad Death Stuff
notes: Card prints 'If ... your opponent's faction'; catalog uses updated templating 'When ... an opponent's faction'.

name: Dethmürderblüdgeon, the Craghammer
subtitle: batteries not included
rules: UNIQUE DETHMÜRDERBLÜDGEON -- ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- The attached character gains 2 strength and 2 life. -- If the attached character is blocked, your opponent's faction loses 2 influence. -- If the attached character inflicts damage to a faction, you may pick a character. If you do, inflict 2 damage to that character. -- If this card would go to your discard pile from play, put it into your hand instead.
printing: ARTIST SERIES (Limited edition artwork by Patrick Meehan)
notes: Footer reads 'Limited edition artwork by Patrick Meehan'. Catalog uses updated templating (When/an opponent's/its owner's hand) for the same effects.

name: Dragon Catheter
subtitle: it's disturbingly comfortable
rules: At the start of your turn, put a token on the character with the highest strength. If there is a tie, you decide which character gets the token. -- All characters gain 1 strength for each token on them.
flavor: "Well at least our job is better than the guys who have to clean up."

name: Dragon Juice
subtitle: what did you think the catheter was for?
rules: COST – Pick a character. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character gains 5 strength.
notes: Catalog says EXTRA COST: where card prints COST –.

name: Dragon Rider
subtitle: commanding from above
rules: This card gains 1 strength and 1 life for each "dragon" card you control.
flavor: A dragon and his rider are peers. The rider rides at the will of the dragon. They are the captains of the field, circling the battle, landing only to deliver punishment where needed.
notes: Card puts "dragon" in quotes; catalog omits quotes.

name: Dragon Tank
subtitle: delivers the biggest beatings ever
rules: At the start of your turn, you may pick a character your opponent controls. If you do, destroy it. Otherwise, destroy this card.
flavor: Pulled into battle by mighty basks, the dragon tank is feared above all else. Even if its victims can disable the enormous machinery, the basks remain to spew their acidic venom in an annihilating torrent of pain.
notes: Card prints 'a character your opponent controls'; catalog says 'an opponent controls'.

name: Dragon's Quarters
subtitle: dragonomically designed
rules: At the start of your turn, you may pick a character. If you do, this card inflicts X+1 damage to it, where X is the number of "dragon" cards you control.
flavor: "Excuse me?...Is this barracks handicap acce...Oh no! ARGH! NO! <blumph> <mumph> crunch, crunch, crunch, crunch, munch...gulp...<BURP>..."
notes: Card puts "dragon" in quotes; catalog omits quotes.

name: Elbow Dropper
subtitle: i can't believe it! that's gotta hurt!
rules: OFF THE TOP ROPE -- COST – Deplete this card. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character cannot block.
flavor: "Illegal, Mean Jean!"

name: Explosive Fury
subtitle: a spontaneous event
rules: COST – Pick a character you control. X is its strength. Destroy it. Pick another character. -- EFFECT – Inflict X damage to the character.
flavor: Warning: dragon juice may cause indigestion, fever, rage, unexplained weight gain, turgidity, and sudden onset auto-combustion.
printing: ARTIST SERIES (Limited edition artwork by Patrick Meehan)
notes: Catalog says EXTRA COST: where card prints COST –. Footer reads 'Limited edition artwork by Patrick Meehan'. Flavor first word looks like 'Waming' (tight rn kerning) in the image; transcribed as 'Warning'.

name: Eye Gouge
subtitle: less talking, more screaming
rules: COST – Pick a blocking character. -- EFFECT – Inflict 3 damage to the character.
flavor: "Ach! My eyes! The goggles, they do nothing!"
notes: Catalog says EXTRA COST: where card prints COST –.

name: Flaming Barduse
subtitle: harbinger of sticky, burning doom
rules: COST – You may pick 2 or fewer characters. -- When this card enters play, if you picked characters as part of its cost, inflict up to 2 damage divided however you want to those characters.
flavor: "In a state of supreme agitation, the mighty barduse vomits a sticky, viscous mess which bursts into a white-hot flame, consuming everything it touches."
notes: Catalog says EXTRA COST: where card prints COST –.

name: Fleshripping Scenepuller
subtitle: his face? i didn't like it.
rules: If this card is blocked, this turn it gains 4 strength for each member in the opposing party.
flavor: He'll beat you to death, eat your flesh, and sew your skin into his clothing. And if you're very, very lucky, he'll do it in that order.
notes: Card prints 'If this card is blocked'; catalog uses updated 'When'.

name: Gore Engine
subtitle: accept no substitutes
rules: If a character is destroyed during a turn when this card damaged it, put X tokens on this card, where X is the strength of that character. -- This card gains 1 strength for each token on it. -- IMPALE -- COST – Pay 2 or remove 2 tokens from this card. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character must block this card if it can.
printing: ARTIST SERIES (Limited edition artwork by Ivan Ng)
notes: Card prints 'If a character is destroyed'; catalog uses 'When'. Catalog says EXTRA COST:-style label for the ability cost as COST:. Artist Series watermark visible in text box.

name: Hammer Smash
subtitle: if your head gets in the way, too bad
rules: COST – Flip a coin. If you win, X is 2. Otherwise, X is 1. Pick X or fewer items. -- EFFECT – Destroy the items.
notes: Catalog says EXTRA COST: where card prints COST –.

name: Heirloom Incinerator
subtitle: destroyer of ancestry and culture
rules: If this card inflicts damage to a faction, you may pick an item. If you do, destroy it.
flavor: "Quit your blubbering old man! You *and* your stuff are going to a better place!"
notes: Card prints 'If this card inflicts damage'; catalog uses updated 'When'.

name: Hidden Sniper
rules: SHARPSHOOT -- COST – Pay 1. Deplete this card. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Inflict 1 damage to the character.

name: Humiliating Torture Apparatus
subtitle: stop smiling, it hurts!
rules: If a card is depleted, that card's controller's faction loses 1 influence. (Resources don't deplete when used; they attach to your faction.)
flavor: Some torturers disguise their identities. They save the cutest costumes for their cruelest atrocities.
notes: Card prints 'If a card is depleted'; catalog uses updated 'When'.

name: Menacing Mauler
subtitle: run away!
rules: If this card is blocked, inflict 1 damage to each member of the blocking party.
printing: ARTIST SERIES (Limited edition artwork by Zi Jian)
notes: Card prints 'If this card is blocked'; catalog uses updated 'When'. Artist Series watermark visible in text box.

name: Morale Officer
subtitle: brings out the best in his men
rules: CONVINCE -- COST – Deplete this card. -- EFFECT – This turn, all your "soldier" characters gain 1 strength.
flavor: "And when we're done, I have no doubt you'll embrace the good and truth of our cause."
notes: Card puts "soldier" in quotes; catalog omits quotes.

name: Murderous Commander
subtitle: next!
rules: CUNNING PLAN -- COST – Pay 2. Discard a card. Deplete this card. -- EFFECT – Inflict 2 damage to your opponent's faction.
flavor: "You see killmajigs have a preset kill limit. Knowing their weakness, I sent wave after wave of my own men at them...until they reached their limit and shut down."
notes: Card prints 'your opponent's faction'; catalog says 'an opponent's faction'.

name: Needless Beating
subtitle: a typical Direstock birthday celebration
rules: COST – Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Inflict 2 damage to the character. If your opponent's faction has 15 influence or less, inflict 1 additional damage to the character. If your opponent's faction has 10 influence or less, inflict 1 damage to each character your opponent controls. If your opponent's faction has 5 influence or less, draw a card.
printing: Limited edition artwork by Silvia Gunarso
notes: Printed cost is just 'Pick a character.' (any character, including your own); catalog cost is 'Pick an opponent. Pick a character that player controls.' which restricts the target to that opponent's characters, and catalog refers to 'that player's faction' instead of 'your opponent's faction'. Same in a 2-player game except the printed card can target any character. Multiplayer re-templating but a target restriction change, so marked different.

name: Oversoon Lightfoot
subtitle: the battle is next Tuesday
flavor: Early to rise, early to die.
notes: Subtitle underlines the word 'next'.

name: Penetrate
subtitle: sometimes a ram is just a ram
rules: COST – Pick an attacking character you control. -- EFFECT – If the character assigns battle damage to the blocking party during this battle, assign it to the target of the attack instead.
notes: Catalog says EXTRA COST: and 'would assign' where card prints COST – and 'assigns'.

name: Pinch
subtitle: i peench
rules: COST – Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Inflict 1 damage to the character.
flavor: Maybe just a little peench?
notes: Catalog says EXTRA COST: where card prints COST –.

name: Plodding Brute
subtitle: killing at his own pace
flavor: Large and uncoordinated, the Brutes travel just behind the main army to ensure that survivors won't be overlooked.

name: Rabid Sarume
subtitle: bookish and brutal
rules: When this card enters play, inflict 1 damage to all your opponent's characters.
flavor: "Let's see...sarcophyle, sardines... ah, here it is. Sarume... aaaaaauuuugh!"

name: Raging Bask
subtitle: bloated reptile on a vomitous rampage
rules: While this card is attacking, you may assign its battle damage to the target of the attack instead of the blocking party.
flavor: Basks are theorized to be nothing more than a tiny brain atop a mountain of bile. None have survived to validate this claim.

name: Really Big Barduse
subtitle: i didn't know you played the ass-trombone!
rules: COST – You may pick 2 or fewer characters. -- When this card enters play, if you picked characters as part of its cost, inflict up to 5 damage divided however you want to those characters.
flavor: "It's not the random devouring that bothers me. It's the way he plays with them first."
notes: Catalog says EXTRA COST: where card prints COST –.

name: Reckless Challenger
subtitle: fearless and foolish
rules: At the end of your turn, if this card started the turn under your control and did not attack this turn, destroy it.
flavor: "I don't care if it's one at a time or all together...I'm going to make ALL OF YOU my bitch."

name: Reveille Tower
subtitle: echoing the anthems of tyranny
rules: All your characters gain 1 strength.
flavor: Its chilling sound slices the morning air like a razor-sharp sword. The eerie melody foreshadows the dawn of a dark age.

name: Rudo Mangod
subtitle: frightful adonis of infamous temperament
rules: UNIQUE RUDOLPHUS -- PUNCH -- COST – Pay 2. Deplete this card. Pick a character. X is its strength. Y is this card's strength. -- EFFECT – Inflict X damage to this card. Inflict Y damage to the character.

name: Ruthless Platoon
subtitle: Bob was tasty for a thin guy
rules: CANNIBALIZE -- COST – Destroy a character you control. -- EFFECT – This turn, this card gains 2 strength.
flavor: "You know most people overlook it, but there's a lot of good meat on the face."

name: Sadistic Colonel
subtitle: eeny, meeny, miney, moe
rules: If your opponent plays a tactic, inflict 2 damage to their faction.
flavor: Colonel Blastwad always makes inspection a lot of fun!
notes: Card prints 'If your opponent plays a tactic'; catalog uses updated 'When an opponent deploys a tactic'.

name: Scout
subtitle: omen of the coming horde
flavor: Only the most disagreeable warriors are chosen to be scouts. They comb the countryside in disguise, searching for riches, women, and easily killed men. A town can only pray that it has less of these things than its neighbors.

name: Shriever Attack
subtitle: they'll creatively assist you in dying
rules: Inflict 2 damage to all characters.
flavor: "I ascended the peak towards Avery's Hem. The shear nervy demeanor of the raven shyer filled my soul with a rasher envy. But alas, the sound of the haver syren from Neva Sherry foretold the dangers of these hills...a cancer these shrievers be!" — Henry Raves, nailer of The Style
notes: Flavor attribution is inline on the same text line as the quote (not a separate line).

name: Siege Machine
subtitle: intimidating weapon of penetration
rules: BATTERING RAM -- COST – Pay 2. Destroy a resource you control. -- EFFECT – Your opponent's faction loses 1 influence.
flavor: "I will not sacrifice this city. We've made too many compromises already; too many retreats. They invade our fields, and we fall back. They eradicate entire towns, and we fall back. Not again. The line must be drawn HERE! This far, NO FURTHER! And I will make them pay for what they've done."
notes: Card prints 'Your opponent's faction'; catalog says 'An opponent's faction'.

name: Skewer
subtitle: everyone gets a turn
rules: COST – Choose a number for X. Pay X+X. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Inflict X damage to the character.
flavor: "Eww... looks like that one had corn for dinner."
notes: Catalog says EXTRA COST: where card prints COST –.

name: Skin Suit
subtitle: wear it while it's wet
rules: COST – Pick a character you control. X is its strength. Pick a character your opponent controls. Y is its strength. -- EFFECT – Inflict X damage to your opponent's character and Y damage to your character simultaneously. If only 1 of the characters is destroyed by this damage, remove it from the game instead. The surviving character gains all rules text of the removed character.
notes: Catalog says EXTRA COST:, 'an opponent controls' / 'that opponent's character' and 'would be destroyed' where card prints COST –, 'your opponent controls' / 'your opponent's character' and 'is destroyed'.

name: Splattergun
subtitle: the room looks better in red
rules: UNLOAD -- COST – Deplete this card. Pick a character or faction. -- EFFECT – Inflict 3 damage to the character or faction. Your opponent takes control of this card.
notes: Card: 'Your opponent takes control of this card.' Catalog: 'That faction's or character's controller takes control of this card.' These differ if you pick your own character/faction (catalog: you keep the card; printed: opponent takes it). Same result in 2-player when targeting an opponent's thing. Multiplayer re-templating, but could change gameplay, so marked different.

name: Stalwart Soldier
subtitle: rejecting the moral decay of his brethren
flavor: "It was early winter when I went forth from my home base. After many months I found a cave containing tropical coconuts. Using these I fashioned a crude hovel and lived in it for several days. Soon I befriended a pack of bears and we traveled east, towards Macaroon. There I took up small odd jobs under the name of Mister Pilkington. But perhaps I've said too much..."

name: Suicide Squad
subtitle: perhaps today is a good day to die!
rules: ULTIMATE SACRIFICE -- COST – X is this card's strength. Destroy this card. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Inflict X damage to the character.
flavor: "...prepare for ramming speed!"

name: Tactician Vacation
subtitle: effective immediately
rules: Your opponent cannot respond to this card. -- If you played this card in response to a tactic, terminate the tactic. This turn, tactics cannot be played.
flavor: In fact, take the rest of the week off too.
notes: Card prints 'Your opponent cannot respond to this card' and 'played'; catalog restates it as 'EXTRA COST: Your opponents cannot respond to this card' and uses 'deployed'.

name: Target Practice
subtitle: drunken pastime of the cruel
rules: COST – Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Inflict 2 damage to the character.
flavor: "I like to nail 'em right after they take the first bite. Whammo! Right between the eyes, granny!"
notes: Catalog says EXTRA COST: where card prints COST –.

name: Thundering Nilpha
subtitle: crushing coils of carnage
rules: While this card is attacking a location, it gains 1 strength and cannot be blocked.
flavor:
Smashed into pulp, dashed to bloody ribbons on the rocks, spined and impaled, devoured and ingested, boiled alive in the churning belly of the demon.
Good times.

name: Torrential Bleeder
subtitle: let the death shower begin!
rules: At the start of your turn, inflict 1 damage to all characters.
flavor: "Damn you bleedy buggers! Damn you to hell!"

name: Trip Wire
subtitle: always good for a chuckle
rules: COST – Play this only while you are being attacked. -- EFFECT – Inflict up to 3 damage divided however you want to the attacking characters.
notes: Catalog says EXTRA COST: and 'Deploy' where card prints COST – and 'Play'.

name: Trophy Collector
subtitle: only the finest frankfurters
rules: COST – Play this only if your opponent's faction has 10 influence or less.
flavor: After eight months of beans and hardtack, you don't ask where the meat comes from.
printing: ARTIST SERIES (Limited edition artwork by Zi Jian)
notes: Catalog says EXTRA COST:, 'Deploy' and 'an opponent's faction' where card prints COST –, 'Play' and 'your opponent's faction'. Artist Series watermark visible in text box.

name: Warrior Prodigy
subtitle: just a morning workout
flavor: The most talented fighters are encouraged from a young age. They're given all the food they can eat, all the women they can handle, and all the men they can kill.

name: Wyrmfang Deathskull
subtitle: who lives in a pineapple under the sea?
rules: UNIQUE WYRMFANG -- If you attack, your opponent picks any number of characters they control. Those characters must block during this battle if they can, and only those characters can block.
flavor: WYRM-FANG-DEATH-SKULL!
notes: Card prints 'If you attack, your opponent picks...'; catalog uses 'When you attack, the controller of the faction or location you are attacking picks...' (same in a 2-player game). Flavor line is bold italic, DEATH-SKULL in larger bold.
